title: Cosmo explains how to keep an anime adult reading as an adult
description: Fabio, 2026-10-13: the picture check refused an ILL Anime start frame (school uniform + classroom). In anime the face barely carries age, so the user needs to know the cues: face shape (round = young, longer face/sharper jaw = older), clothes (school uniform vs adult wear), setting, hair, and that a numeric age does nothing on Illustrious while mature female works. Add a short section to Cosmo's two anime guides, docs/agent/models/illustrious.md and pony.md, so Cosmo prompts adults that read as adults and can explain a CHILD_SAFETY refusal in those terms.
